label: GO after a reward with a saturated a2 commitment and only moderate value (late episode, S2 good)
explanation: Fires only at GO (100% of mass), only when the previous trial was rewarded (in_rew=1 at D1), and only when the policy chooses a2 very strongly (all activations have choice logit diff < -8.91, the bottom decile; model_act=2 always; next action a2 in 10564/10566). It is concentrated late in the episode (trials 70-99, about 91% of mass; none before trial 10) and when S2 is good (84% of mass), mostly on stays after common-rewarded a2 trials. It never fires at D1 or D2, after unrewarded trials, or on a1 choices. Within that set it prefers lower value: none fire with value > 8.10, and value < 7.13 holds 89% of mass. Magnitude increases as the choice logit gets more extreme (choice < -10 & prev_reward holds 58% of mass on 30% of activations). GO & prev_reward & choice < -8.91 gives recall 1.0 but precision 0.14. The recorded predicate (choice < -9.5, value < 7.13) gives dev precision 0.87, recall 0.52, mass recall 0.80, F1 0.65. The edge looks like a soft threshold on a continuous combination of policy confidence and value, so the boolean form is only partial. Only observed quantities are used: prev reward plus the model's own value and policy outputs at this step.
